dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature along the posterior margin, exhibiting a smooth falcate spline from the basal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded classification with a moderate pixel radius curvature at the highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40 to 45 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex arc forming a smooth, rounded forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt beak extending from the melon with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle (approximately 150 degrees) at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible circular depigmented spots and small dark punctate marks on the anterior-dorsal surface of the melon; faint linear striations on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme specular reflection and pixel saturation across the mid-lateral and dorsal regions, obscuring fine dermal texture.
